---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new rigging feature, mover, tool, or integration
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem or inspiration

What rigging capability is missing, and what use case needs it (a real
character, an engine integration, an agent workflow).

## Proposed design

How it would fit the RigExec model: is it a solver, a constraint, a mover,
an authoring API, or a viewer tool? Sketch the node/operation behavior.

## Alternatives considered

Existing rigs or engines that solve this, and why an in-USD solution is
better.
